definitions.explanation: Showing great attention to detail; finely crafted or intricately made.

examples.japanese: {精緻|せいち}な{細工|さいく}だ。
{精緻|せいち}な{模様|もよう}が{施|ほどこ}されている。
この{論文|ろんぶん}は{精緻|せいち}な{分析|ぶんせき}で{知|し}られている。
examples.english: This paper is known for its meticulous analysis.

notes:
{精緻|せいち} describes something made with extreme care and attention to detail, often implying high quality craftsmanship or careful work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精緻|せいち}な{細工|さいく}: elaborate craftsmanship
- {精緻|せいち}な{模様|もよう}: intricate pattern
- {精緻|せいち}な{分析|ぶんせき}: detailed analysis
- {精緻|せいち}な{作|つく}り: fine workmanship

USAGE NOTES:
- Formal/literary word
- Used for art, crafts, academic work, or any finely detailed work
- Implies positive evaluation of quality and care
